title: Merry’s Seven Wishes
description:
Richard has lost the person who meant everything to him. After Merry's death, his world has literally lost its color.

Then he finds a letter.

Before she died, Merry left behind seven final wishes — seven things she wants Richard to do without her. What begins as a painful reminder of everything he has lost gradually becomes a journey through their memories, their relationship, and the life they shared.

 

FULFILL HER SEVEN FINAL WISHES

Each wish takes Richard somewhere new — and brings back memories of the life he shared with Merry.

Available in English, German, Italian, Ukrainian, French, Spanish, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese with full interface and subtitle support.
description_short: After his wife Merry dies, Richard finds a letter containing seven final wishes she left behind. Fulfill them one by one, revisit the memories of their life together, and slowly bring color back into a world that has turned completely gray.
